001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import org.bukkit.World;
005import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
008
009/**
010 * @author netherfoam Represents an economy.
011 */
012public interface EconomyCore {
013
014  /**
015   * Deposits a given amount of money from thin air to the given username.
016   *
017   * @param obj      The object of one of type: UUID, OfflinePlayer, String
018   * @param amount   The amount to give them
019   * @param currency The currency name
020   * @param world    The transaction world
021   *
022   * @return True if success (Should be almost always)
023   */
024  boolean deposit(@NotNull QUser obj, double amount, @NotNull World world, @Nullable String currency);
025
026  /**
027   * Formats the given number... E.g. 50.5 becomes $50.5 Dollars, or 50 Dollars 5 Cents
028   *
029   * @param balance  The given number
030   * @param currency The currency name
031   * @param world    The transaction world
032   *
033   * @return The balance in human readable text.
034   */
035  String format(double balance, @NotNull World world, @Nullable String currency);
036
037  /**
038   * Fetches the balance of the given account name
039   *
040   * @param obj      The object of one of type: UUID, OfflinePlayer, String
041   * @param currency The currency name
042   * @param world    The transaction world
043   *
044   * @return Their current balance.
045   */
046  double getBalance(@NotNull QUser obj, @NotNull World world, @Nullable String currency);
047
048  /**
049   * Gets the economy processor last error message
050   *
051   * @return Error message or null if never happens
052   */
053  @Nullable
054  String getLastError();
055
056  /**
057   * Getting Economy impl name
058   *
059   * @return Impl name
060   */
061  @NotNull
062  String getName();
063
064  /**
065   * Getting Economy impl owned by
066   *
067   * @return Owned by
068   */
069  @NotNull
070  Plugin getPlugin();
071
072  /**
073   * Gets the currency does exists
074   *
075   * @param currency Currency name
076   * @param world    The transaction world
077   *
078   * @return exists
079   */
080  boolean hasCurrency(@NotNull World world, @NotNull String currency);
081
082  /**
083   * Checks that this economy is valid. Returns false if it is not valid.
084   *
085   * @return True if this economy will work, false if it will not.
086   */
087  boolean isValid();
088
089  /**
090   * Gets currency supports status
091   *
092   * @return true if supports
093   */
094  boolean supportCurrency();
095
096  /**
097   * Transfers the given amount of money from Player1 to Player2
098   *
099   * @param from     The player who is paying money, The object of one of type: UUID, OfflinePlayer,
100   *                 String
101   * @param to       The player who is receiving money, The object of one of type: UUID,
102   *                 OfflinePlayer, String
103   * @param amount   The amount to transfer
104   * @param currency The currency name
105   * @param world    The transaction world
106   *
107   * @return true if success (Payer had enough cash, receiver was able to receive the funds)
108   */
109  boolean transfer(@NotNull QUser from, @NotNull QUser to, double amount, @NotNull World world, @Nullable String currency);
110
111  /**
112   * Withdraws a given amount of money from the given username and turns it to thin air.
113   *
114   * @param obj      The object of one of type: UUID, OfflinePlayer, String
115   * @param amount   The amount to take from them
116   * @param currency The currency name
117   * @param world    The transaction world
118   *
119   * @return True if success, false if they didn't have enough cash
120   */
121  boolean withdraw(@NotNull QUser obj, double amount, @NotNull World world, @Nullable String currency);
122
123}
